resources.string: Reads the text you type into text fields (never password fields) and asks Gemini whether it might come across as rude, inflammatory, unprofessional or standoffish. Fields get a green, yellow or red glow depending on how risky the wording is, and a button that suggests friendlier rewrites. With the on-device backend your text never leaves the phone; with the cloud backend it is sent to the Gemini API.
Glows green, yellow or red around whatever you type, before you hit send.
Service is ON. Start typing in any app.
Service is OFF. Enable \"Tone Policer\" in Accessibility settings.
Rewrite suggestions (runs when you tap Fix tone)
Auto: on-device first, then cloud, then offline
Cloud mode sends the text of the focused field to Google\'s Gemini API. Password fields are always skipped.
Show the fix-it button at severity %1$d+
Show a green border when the text looks fine
Use the conversation on screen as context
Lets Gemini check whether your reply acknowledges, thanks or empathizes with what the other person said. In cloud mode this visible text is sent to Google too.
Their message (optional), e.g. "Ugh, my flight got cancelled and I'm stuck at the airport."
Your reply, e.g. "Can you still send me the slides tonight?"
